sources.claim: In 2000 Netflix co-founders offered to sell the company to Blockbuster for $50 million and were turned down
sources.source: Newsweek fact-check; Yahoo Finance; multiple corroborating reports citing Netflix co-founder accounts

sources.claim: Blockbuster's then-CEO John Antioco has disputed that a serious sale discussion took place, despite the Netflix founders' account
Netflix launched streaming ('Watch Now') on January 16, 2007, initially as an add-on to the DVD subscription to reduce churn
sources.source: Netflix company history reporting (multiple corroborating sources)

sources.claim: Blockbuster filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2010
